name: Strong Hire: is this a job description / a CV? (IN-6, IN-7)
description: Each document is checked as the input the user gave it as. label_acc is the accept or refuse decision (matches); field_match is the named document kind (looks_like). Slice by expected to read false refusals (accept) and false accepts (refuse) separately. Prompts are Strong Hire's own (built by scripts/build_strong_hire.py); a model with prompt_tier small gets the small-model variant where the row has one.
